items.title: The derived limit of an inverse system agrees with the homotopy limit of its terms

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the two notions of derived limit available for a complex on a product site: the derived functor of the limit and the homotopy limit of the inverse system of its pullbacks to the terms (statement lines 5066-5075). The proof is a complete computation: after choosing a K-injective representative with injective terms the derived limit is computed termwise (proof lines 5078-5088); surjectivity of the transition maps is deduced from the fact that the structure morphisms are monomorphisms (proof lines 5091-5098); and exactness of the left adjoints together with the identification of products with derived products exhibits the derived limit as the homotopy limit (proof lines 5101-5122). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two limit notions. The claim is H2: a computation whose inputs are named and whose steps are written out.
